privacyTitle:

privacyBody: Your saved personal information stays in your browser profile. You choose which sites the extension can access. And the final submit button? That’s always yours.
faqsTitle: A few things you might wonder.
faqs: How is this different from browser autofill?
Fill My Form is built around reusable personal answers, including details beyond the usual name and address fields. Results depend on the form; review them before submitting.
Will it submit a form for me?
No. You stay in control of submission. Check the filled answers and submit the form yourself.
Does the extension support every language and website?
No universal compatibility is promised. This website is available in ten languages; extension language and website support may differ.

privacyPageIntro: A clear view of what stays with you and what this website measures.
privacyDetails: Personal memory is stored locally in your browser’s IndexedDB. It is not encrypted by the extension; protection at rest depends on your device and browser profile. You can export or delete saved data in the extension.

We save your selected language and analytics choice in your browser. Optional Google Analytics receives page visits and install-link clicks only after consent, without form answers or URL query strings. You can withdraw consent in cookie settings.
Site access is granted individually. Form submission remains your action. Optional extension integrations have their own controls and are separate from website analytics.
